**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat conjunction-linked suffixes as bounds**

When `以上` or `以下` is introduced by the common conjunctions `及` or `或`, this suffix grammar no longer attaches the qualifier to the amount. Both `normalizeMoneyValueV4('4000元及以上')` and a cropped `4000元` candidate quoted from `王甲工资4000元或以下` return `exact` with `4000.00`, so a lower or upper bound can become an exact production amount. Allow the bounded conjunction before these suffixes while retaining the existing ordinary-prose continuation guards.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
